cobblemon.species.omega.name: Omegadge
cobblemon.species.gyaoon.name: Gawarhed
cobblemon.species.barunda.name: Balumba
spaceworldmons.species.barunda.desc: This Pokémon has an organ that can convert oxygen into helium, which it stores within it’s body to float freely in the air. Researchers believe that Balumba's unique composition is what made it so elusive.
cobblemon.species.deer.name: Ramoose
cobblemon.species.crocky.name: Gavillain
cobblemon.species.cactus.name: Cactormus
cobblemon.species.jagg.name: Sharpoon
cobblemon.species.kobat.name: Bittybat
spaceworldmons.species.kobat.desc: When Bittybat are first born, their wings are underdeveloped, which leave it unable to maintain consistant flight until evolving into Zubat. They can only drink a little blood at a time, leaving their prey only slightly anemic.
cobblemon.species.mikon.name: Vulpiii
spaceworldmons.species.mikon.desc: According to folklore, touching one of Vulpiii's tails brings one good fortune. Though there are rumors of sightings in several regions, this is unable to be confirmed.
cobblemon.species.kasanagi.name: Pupal
spaceworldmons.species.kasanagi.desc: These sluggish Pokémon are known for their bell-like chirps, which they emit through their mustache-like antenna. During the summer, Pupal gather together and make music, snapping their fingers as they chirp in different pitches.
cobblemon.species.konya.name: Coinpur
spaceworldmons.species.konya.desc: A life of wealth and prosperity is said to come to those who see Coinpur on its hindlegs, with one paw raised in the air. Scientists are baffled by the floating coins above Coinpur’s head.
cobblemon.species.gyopin.name: Orfry
spaceworldmons.species.gyopin.desc: Though most people think Orfry are naturally tiny Pokémon, they can grow to large sizes if given enough space. It was once considered a popular pet, though it has since fallen out of fashion.
cobblemon.species.puchikoon.name: Kolta
spaceworldmons.species.puchikoon.desc: It is big enough to be ridden on by small children. Kolta are often prefered to raise over its fully evolved counterparts, as its flames are immature and rarely cause damage to its trainer.
cobblemon.species.buu.name: Freezeti
cobblemon.species.gurotesu.name: Lurreel
spaceworldmons.species.gurotesu.desc: Lurreel hunts using the weak lure on its head, swallowing it's prey whole. It lurks in the ocean, and the bottoms of deep lakes.
cobblemon.species.ikari.name: Angore
spaceworldmons.species.ikari.desc: Not even the weight of Angore's anchor can slow it down. It's chain of a tail is often used like a wrecking ball.
cobblemon.species.sato.name: Sailwing
spaceworldmons.species.sato.desc: Sailwing has the ability to traverse land, air, and sea. This means that Pokémon everywhere have the chance to eat it. It's body is rich in protein.
cobblemon.species.hanamogura.name: Petamole
spaceworldmons.species.hanamogura.desc: When Chikorita sprouts it's flowers too early, it will turn into Petamole. Their lower bodies shrink into roots, as they need plenty of nutrients to grow into Meganium.
cobblemon.species.honoguma.name: Cubburn
spaceworldmons.species.honoguma.desc: Though very cuddly as a Cubburn, it becomes much harder to handle as it grows up. As such, Fire-type Cyndaquil began to take it's place as a more popular first partner for trainers.
cobblemon.species.borubea.name: Flambear
spaceworldmons.species.borubea.desc: It's body is scorching hot to the touch. While Flambear is still quite friendly, it is not fully aware of it's own strength. As such, it often overwhelms inexperienced trainers.
cobblemon.species.dainabea.name: Bruinus
spaceworldmons.species.dainabea.desc: Bruinus barrels into it's foes with explosive force. It has a fiesty temperament, being willing to fight over the smallest things. Bruinus have been spotted burning down entire forests with flames sparked by it's mane.
cobblemon.species.kurusu.name: Palssio
spaceworldmons.species.kurusu.desc: Palssio was once considered as a first partner for Johto trainers. While Totodile has almost completely replaced it, the most dedicated of trainers will still seek it out.
cobblemon.species.akua.name: Pressio
spaceworldmons.species.akua.desc: It glides across water as if there was little to no resistance. Some think that the teardrop-shaped orb on Pressio's neck is the source of its power.
cobblemon.species.akueria.name: Donmarin
spaceworldmons.species.akueria.desc: An incredibly resilient Pokémon, Donmarin can safely deliver it's trainer through even the stormiest of waters. Sightings have been reported at the Lake of Rage, though Donmarin does not seem to reside there.
cobblemon.species.monja.name: Burgela
spaceworldmons.species.monja.desc: Burgela's vines have yet to fully envelop it's body. While this gives it more mobility, it is very vulnerable in this stage.
cobblemon.species.jaranra.name: Jungela
spaceworldmons.species.jaranra.desc: It lays perfectly still near bodies of water to catch unsuspecting prey, resembling a pile of seaweed. It can unhinge its jaw to devour prey much larger than it. It is not uncommon to see Jungela in groups alongside Tangrowth.
cobblemon.species.madamuu.name: Luxwan
cobblemon.species.twinz.name: Bipulla
spaceworldmons.species.twinz.desc: Both of Bipulla's heads are constantly swirling around. For reasons still unknown, they are always moving clockwise.
cobblemon.species.shibirefugu.name: Kazappelin
cobblemon.species.animon.name: Mimmeo
cobblemon.species.tsubomitto.name: Bellignan
cobblemon.species.wolfman.name: Warfurs
spaceworldmons.species.wolfman.desc: The pelt worn by Warfurs is thought to belong to an unidentified Pokémon. It playfully hops through the snow, keeping blissfully warm beneath the fur.
cobblemon.species.warwolf.name: Wearlycan
spaceworldmons.species.warwolf.desc: It's sheer bulk and heavy coat let Wearlycan march on through temperatures as low as -100°C. It's claws can slice through the hardest of ice.
cobblemon.species.turbann.name: Disturban
spaceworldmons.species.turbann.desc: Shellder take on many different forms depending on how they attach to Slowpoke. It is speculated that Disturban is the result of feeding Shellder severed Slowpoke tails, but few have the heart to test this.
cobblemon.species.rinrin.name: Moibelle
spaceworldmons.species.rinrin.desc: The sound of Moibelle's bell chimes with a brass-like clarity. Though it prefers walking on two legs, Moibelle is as agile as other cats.
cobblemon.species.berurun.name: Belledam
spaceworldmons.species.berurun.desc: Valued for it's looks, Belledam is known to be a difficult Pokémon to raise. When irritated, it flicks it's tail creating an unbearably loud ringing noise.
cobblemon.species.bomushika.name: Grenmar
cobblemon.species.norowara.name: Stromen
cobblemon.species.kyonpan.name: Phandarin
cobblemon.species.plux.name: Tricules
cobblemon.species.para.name: Paraspor
spaceworldmons.species.para.desc: Paraspor's favorite food is Big Mushrooms. It will dive headfirst into the cap, eating it's way back out. However, these mushrooms have a tendency to make Paraspor sick.
cobblemon.species.hinaazu.name: Dodaerie
cobblemon.species.betobebii.name: Smujj
spaceworldmons.species.betobebii.desc: Smujj are formed from excess grime that falls off of Grimer and Muk. Though it's stench isn't strong, finding a cluster of Smujj forming is often a sign of more dangerous pollution nearby.
cobblemon.species.pudi.name: Pupperon
spaceworldmons.species.pudi.desc: Pupperon are known for being friendly and easy to raise. If you ignore it, it will bark incessantly until it gets affection.
cobblemon.species.nameeru.name: Lickilord
spaceworldmons.species.nameeru.desc: In the east, traveling merchants keep Lickilord as security for would-be thieves. It can unfurl its tongue and ensnare a target in seconds, paralyzing them with its spit.
cobblemon.species.hitokakushi.name: Whispirit
cobblemon.species.mitsuboshi.name: Tripstar
cobblemon.species.totta.name: Totta
cobblemon.species.hakkeyo.name: Hakkeyo
cobblemon.species.zuruzu.name: Zuruzu
cobblemon.species.sunorora.name: Snowroara
cobblemon.species.warabbit.name: Watabbit
cobblemon.species.nekkoyagi.name: Tubacapra
